descriptionChirho: Active Qal finite forms and infinitives meaning to kill or slay violently and intentionally, encompassing all persons, numbers, tenses, moods, and pronominal suffixes.
Qal active participle used substantivally to denote a person who kills: killer, slayer, murderer.
Qal passive participle used substantivally or adjectivally for one who has been killed: the slain, the victims.
Nifal and Qal passive finite forms expressing the passive voice: to be killed, to be slain.
